methods.G1: Row explicitly typed Gemeinde/Marktgemeinde/Stadtgemeinde/Statutarstadt; own current P964 binds one 2026 official GKZ, own P31 confirms municipal role without former/cadastral conflict; no parent; official name in row/own labels; same Bundesland and Bezirk (a Statutarstadt is its own district; Wien has no separate county); own P625 within 10 km (sanity corroboration, never sole proof).
methods.O1: Row explicitly typed Ortschaft; own P8384 binds one official OKZ; own P31 Ortschaft, no Gemeinde/former/Katastralgemeinde conflicts; own P131 confirms official Gemeinde GKZ and any parent_id agrees; same Bundesland and Bezirk; official name in row/own labels; own P625 within 2 km.
methods.hold: Unproved or conflicting entities retain population AND year exactly, including unresolved latest identities. No decision-only events admitted; changes do not touch unresolved keys. No population comparison or name-only join establishes identity.

compact_fields.o: official binding including ODS sheet/one-based row/column

scope: Only population and population_year of existing AT rows; official counts are people with main residence at 1 January 2026, not cadastral/municipal substitutes.
